name: Google Model Armor
short: Google Cloud runtime screen for prompt injection, jailbreaks, sensitive data (PII), malicious URLs, responsible-AI and CSAM filters; free 2M tokens/mo then $0.10 per 1M tokens.

plans.name: Free Tier
plans.notes: 2 million tokens per month free (standalone or SCC pay-as-you-go); prompt-injection/jailbreak (up to 65,536 tokens), responsible-AI/CSAM (up to 65,536 tokens), sensitive-data (up to 130,000 tokens), and malicious-URL (first 256 URLs) screening; 1,200 QPM per project; inspect-only or inspect-and-block; skipped/over-limit data is not charged.

plans.name: Standalone pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Same filters and quotas beyond the free allowance; counts tokens in both prompts and responses (a token is ~4 characters); files/images up to 4 MB; inputs under 3 words return NO_MATCH_FOUND from the injection filter.

plans.name: SCC Premium / Enterprise
plans.notes: Security Command Center Premium and Enterprise subscriptions include 3 billion tokens per month at the same $0.10/1M overage; SCC pay-as-you-go entries use the 2M free tier.

plans.name: Gemini Enterprise
plans.notes: Model Armor is included with all Gemini Enterprise editions; confirm which integration traffic is covered and how usage appears in billing.
